stimulus_or_corner: 4x11.2 F; 106 mOhm/cell; 9.0 V initial OCV; 85% Boost; 145 mOhm output path; 100 mOhm pack path
measurements: PACK_4S; VIN_BOOST; LOAD_12V; input/output current
pass_criteria: >=1.200 s before the validated Boost input floor or any cell UV cutoff

stimulus_or_corner: 1 A output; 2.04 A pack current near 7 V Boost input; hot PCB and connectors
measurements: 4-wire resistance from PACK_4S Kelvin to VIN_BOOST
pass_criteria: <=100 mOhm total at worst operating temperature

stimulus_or_corner: Same as SYS-001 with 150 mOhm pack path
measurements: PACK_4S; VIN_BOOST; LOAD_12V
pass_criteria: Model boundary only: >=1.200 s with <=20 ms margin; not a design target

stimulus_or_corner: EOL model; 1.2 s at 12 W; worst input current about 2.04 A
measurements: Each cell current; cell terminal voltage; cell case temperature
pass_criteria: No cell below validated minimum; temperature rise and pulse repetition meet Eaton application limits

stimulus_or_corner: Sweep PACK_4S slowly in CV mode over VIN_MAIN and temperature corners
measurements: PACK_4S Kelvin; CV_REF; CHG_FB; charge current
pass_criteria: Static CV trip/regulation 9.0580-9.0921 V; no sustained oscillation

stimulus_or_corner: Ramp PACK_4S through threshold at 0.05 A and 0.5 A; include worst input and temperature
measurements: PACK_4S peak; OVP_REF; OVP_OK; Q601 VGS; charge current
pass_criteria: Static threshold 9.2451-9.3049 V; measured peak never exceeds 9.400 V

stimulus_or_corner: Exercise each cell input independently with other cells in normal range
measurements: CELL1-CELL4; CHG_OVP_OD; Buck EN; Q601 VGS; charge current
pass_criteria: Static trip 2.449-2.551 V/cell; dynamic peak remains below 2.700 V

stimulus_or_corner: Hold MCU in reset/high-Z; inject cell OVP and pack OVP; open one sense wire
measurements: CHG_EN; CHG_OVP_OD; Q601 VGS; pack current
pass_criteria: Any fault or invalid sense state physically blocks charging without firmware

stimulus_or_corner: 0.1-0.5 A charge sweep at 10.8/12/13.2 V input (input range provisional)
measurements: R101 differential voltage; INA180 output; pack current
pass_criteria: 0.500 A nominal; provisional acceptance +/-5% pending adapter and thermal specification

stimulus_or_corner: EOL and capacity-ratio 1.00/1.08 cells; prebiased and discharged pack
measurements: Charge current; all cell voltages; CV loop output; pack voltage
pass_criteria: No cell OVP; no repeated CC/CV hunting; final rested pack OCV >=9.000 V

stimulus_or_corner: Inject small-signal perturbation in CC, CV and transition modes
measurements: Loop gain; phase; gain margin; output ripple
pass_criteria: Phase margin >=45 degrees (target 60 degrees); gain margin >=10 dB; crossover below fsw/10

stimulus_or_corner: BQ76905 4S configuration; ramp each cell independently; verify at 1.00-1.10 V window
measurements: Cell input pins; ALERT; CUV status; DISCHARGE_ARM
pass_criteria: Provisional trip window 1.00-1.10 V/cell; final window must be justified by Eaton cell limits and ADC error

stimulus_or_corner: Apply 2.04 A equivalent discharge at weakest-cell corner
measurements: Cell terminal voltage; ALERT; Q501/Q502 VGS; pack current
pass_criteria: Detection-to-physical-isolation <=5 ms; no cell below 1.00 V terminal voltage

stimulus_or_corner: BQ76905 unconfigured, reset, BAT brownout, I2C CRC/config failure, cell tap open
measurements: REGOUT; ALERT; CELL_PROTECT_VALID; DISCHARGE_ARM
pass_criteria: CELL_PROTECT_VALID=0 and DISCHARGE_ARM=0 for every invalid-monitor case

stimulus_or_corner: Cell rises above CUV threshold; pack voltage rebounds after load disconnect
measurements: ALERT; fault latch; ARM request; Q501/Q502 VGS
pass_criteria: No automatic re-enable; require explicit re-arm after ARM has first been observed low

stimulus_or_corner: Slow ramp up/down with real Q503/Q504 receiver loading
measurements: PACK_4S; PACK_UV_OK; DISCHARGE_ARM
pass_criteria: Falling 6.840-7.110 V and rising 7.285-7.499 V, or revised measured window

stimulus_or_corner: 12 W discharge to cutoff; leave load attached and then remove
measurements: PACK_4S; VIN_BOOST; PACK_UV_OK; Q501/Q502 VGS
pass_criteria: No repeated connect/disconnect; fault remains latched until explicit re-arm

stimulus_or_corner: Sweep VIN_BOOST 7.0-9.4 V, 12 V/1 A, min/max CIN/COUT and temperature
measurements: VIN_BOOST; VOUT; inductor current; SW; IC temperature
pass_criteria: Regulation and current stress meet TPS61088 limits; measured efficiency >=85% at worst EOL point

stimulus_or_corner: VIN min; load step and output short; RILIM tolerance and both MODE states
measurements: Inductor peak current; SW waveform; output current
pass_criteria: ILIM,max <=0.8 x guaranteed Isat,min, or select a higher-Isat inductor

stimulus_or_corner: Measure/derive MLCC capacitance at 7-9.4 V input and 12 V output bias
measurements: CIN; COUT; ripple; ESR
pass_criteria: CIN effective >=35 uF; COUT effective >=47 uF; ESR model correlated to board

stimulus_or_corner: Main source valid; start Boost and eFuse before removing main
measurements: VIN_MAIN; BOOST_12V; variant-specific eFuse status (PG/PGTH only on 474x); IN2; ST; LOAD_12V
pass_criteria: Main remains selected until BACKUP_READY; no output below load minimum

stimulus_or_corner: Open eFuse with 100 uF input capacitor; remove main after 1 ms and after 100 ms
measurements: IN2; OV2; variant-specific eFuse status (PG/PGTH only on 474x); TPS2121 ST; LOAD_12V
pass_criteria: Residual IN2 voltage alone never qualifies backup; invalid backup is blocked

stimulus_or_corner: Backup supplies load; restore main with slow ramp and chatter
measurements: Both source currents; LOAD_12V; ST; IN1/IN2
pass_criteria: Main priority restored without prohibited reverse current or repeated toggling

stimulus_or_corner: 1 A steady and load-step during source transfer
measurements: LOAD_12V minimum/maximum; source currents
pass_criteria: Must meet load owner's min/max voltage and interruption specification; currently TBD

stimulus_or_corner: Remove each auxiliary rail; reset MCU; open sense and control connectors
measurements: CHG_EN; Q601 VGS; DISCHARGE_ARM; Q501/Q502 VGS
pass_criteria: Every invalid or unpowered state defaults to charge OFF and discharge OFF

stimulus_or_corner: KiCad ERC, netlist export, hierarchical pin and power-domain audit
measurements: ERC report; netlist; pin-to-net diff
pass_criteria: 0 ERC errors/warnings; no unintended cross-domain connection; all safety nets have defined inactive states

stimulus_or_corner: Check MPN, footprint, ratings, thermal, creepage, copper and test access
measurements: BOM; PCB DRC; assembly drawing; test-point list
pass_criteria: No TBD critical protection part; hot-path resistance and test access documented

stimulus_or_corner: PACK_UV_OK low while ARM active
measurements: ARM_PERMIT; DISCHARGE_ARM; BOOST_EN; Q504 VGS
pass_criteria: DISCHARGE_ARM and BOOST_EN fall and Q504 gate returns to off state

stimulus_or_corner: REGOUT below TPS3839G33 threshold
measurements: REGOUT; CELL_MON_PG; ARM_PERMIT; DISCHARGE_ARM
pass_criteria: CELL_MON_PG low clears ARM and no automatic re-arm after recovery

stimulus_or_corner: CELL_CONFIG_VALID low or host connector open
measurements: CELL_CONFIG_VALID; ARM_PERMIT; DISCHARGE_ARM
pass_criteria: ARM remains cleared and R914 holds configuration-valid low

stimulus_or_corner: CELL_MON_ALERT_L low while ARM active
measurements: CELL_MON_ALERT_L; ARM_PERMIT; DISCHARGE_ARM; BOOST_EN
pass_criteria: ARM and BOOST_EN clear asynchronously and remain off after ALERT releases

stimulus_or_corner: hold MANUAL_ARM_REQ high during fault then restore all safe inputs
measurements: MANUAL_ARM_REQ; ARM_PERMIT; DISCHARGE_ARM
pass_criteria: DISCHARGE_ARM stays low until ARM request is driven low and a new rising edge occurs

stimulus_or_corner: MANUAL_ARM_REQ rising edge with all safe inputs valid
measurements: DISCHARGE_ARM; BOOST_EN_DELAY; BOOST_EN; VIN_BOOST
pass_criteria: BOOST_EN rises 40-100 ms after DISCHARGE_ARM and not before the pack switch is enabled

stimulus_or_corner: clear ARM while BOOST_EN is high
measurements: DISCHARGE_ARM; BOOST_EN_DELAY; BOOST_EN; D910 current
pass_criteria: BOOST_EN falls within 1 ms after ARM clear

stimulus_or_corner: slow ramp CELL_3V3 through supervisor threshold
measurements: CELL_3V3; CELL_MON_PG; reset release delay
pass_criteria: CELL_MON_PG stays low below threshold and releases only after specified delay

stimulus_or_corner: remove J910 or leave host outputs high impedance
measurements: CELL_CONFIG_VALID; MANUAL_ARM_REQ; DISCHARGE_ARM; BOOST_EN
pass_criteria: R914 and R915 keep inputs low and no unintended ARM or Boost start occurs

stimulus_or_corner: PGTH divider senses eFuse OUT; sweep PGTH across rising/falling threshold corners
measurements: OUT; PGTH; PG; BACKUP_READY; OV2
pass_criteria: PG cannot assert before inrush completes; guaranteed HIGH only above 1.223 V and LOW only below 1.076 V; 12 us deglitch is typical, not a maximum

stimulus_or_corner: Apply output short with charged COUT; monitor OUT and PGTH decay
measurements: IN; OUT; PGTH; PG; OV2; LOAD_12V
pass_criteria: PG follows PGTH; residual output capacitance can delay PG low; external fast output-window detector and system latch must prevent false READY

scenario: TPS259474L overload versus short latch semantics
stimulus_or_corner: RILM=1.65 kOhm; persistent overload beyond ITIMER; output hard short
measurements: I_OUT; OUT; PG; EN/UVLO; system fault latch
pass_criteria: Persistent circuit-breaker overload latches off on 474L; output short uses fast-trip/current-limit and is not internally latched; external system latch required

scenario: simultaneous main loss and backup fault
stimulus_or_corner: Remove VIN_MAIN while forcing eFuse PG/OUT fault and retaining IN2/OUT capacitor charge
measurements: VIN_MAIN; IN2; OUT; PG; OV2; ST; LOAD_12V
pass_criteria: No false sustained backup qualification; worst-case PG/OV2/selector timing and load minimum must be guaranteed or measured

stimulus_or_corner: Keep logic pull-up alive while removing eFuse IN and local device power
measurements: PG; VLOGIC; receiver input; BACKUP_READY
pass_criteria: Unpowered PG cannot be interpreted as HIGH; receiver must have a defined default-low state and no back-power path
